The structure of DyHf(CoO3)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—Dy2Hf2Co4O12—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co in octahedral O environments, Dy in a close-packed-like 12-fold O arrangement, Hf in a tetrahedral O environment, and O centers with two or three geometric neighbors. Corner-sharing between Co octahedra and Hf tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Co octahedra, are among the validated polyhedron contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
